blocks.text: Default to pgvector: one database, transactional consistency, SQL filtering. Add a dedicated vector DB like Qdrant only for scale, filtered-search latency or quantization needs.

rows: Up to millions on one box

items: The dimension is fixed (`vector(384)`, `size: 384`): a new model means a new column/collection and full re-embed.
Distance must match the model (usually cosine): `vector_cosine_ops` + `<=>`, or `Distance.COSINE`.
ANN trades recall for speed: regressions show up as worse answers, not errors.

blocks.text: Q: "pgvector or a dedicated vector DB?" A: "pgvector by default: one system, transactional consistency and SQL filters. Move to Qdrant or similar when scale, filtered-search latency or quantization justifies another stateful service and the dual-write consistency work."

items: Fewer moving parts wins by default.
